response.description: Azure Site Recovery now lets you use and attach an existing, pre-provisioned Network Interface Card (NIC) in the target region for test-failover and failover in the Azure-to-Azure scenario. This helps preserve prepared networking configurations, reserve IPs in the target region and more, giving you greater control over the disaster recovery environment. Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: BYON (Bring Your Own NIC) in Azure Site Recovery
